item.title: ‘Removed brain with spoon’: Mentally ill NYC teen beheads mom’s boyfriend - mother recounts chilling chain of events
item.description: A shocking incident unfolded in Staten Island where a mother recounted her son's alleged brutal killing of her boyfriend. The young man, reportedly battling mental illness, is accused of a horrific act. His mother believes his medical care was mishandled, leading to this tragedy. Authorities are investigating the disturbing details of the crime scene.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pakistan fumes over India-Afghanistan talks: Rattled over joint statement, lodges protest to Kabul; objects to terror remarks
item.description: Pakistan has formally objected to Afghanistan's Ambassador regarding the India-Afghanistan joint statement, particularly its reference to Jammu and Kashmir as part of India. Islamabad also rejected Afghan Foreign Minister Muttaqi's assertion that terrorism is Pakistan's internal problem, citing terrorist elements operating from Afghan soil.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Israel doesn’t want war’: Iran says Russia relayed Netanyahu’s message; raises doubt over Gaza ceasefire
item.description: Russia has conveyed a message from Israel to Iran. Prime Minister Netanyahu reportedly told President Putin that Israel does not seek a new war with Iran. This comes after a recent 12-day conflict. Iran remains skeptical of Israel's commitment to a Gaza ceasefire. Tehran supports initiatives to halt hostilities and protect Palestinian rights.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE defeats Oman 2-1 in AFC World Cup qualifiers, tops group A; edges closer to 2026 FIFA World Cup
item.description: The UAE secured a vital 2-1 comeback victory over Oman in the AFC World Cup qualifiers, propelled by key tactical substitutions and late goals from Marcos Miloni and Caio Lucas. This win places the UAE atop Group A, bringing them within reach of their first World Cup appearance since 1990, setting the stage for a decisive clash against Qatar next.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Gaza peace deal: Hamas says hostage release to ‘begin on Monday’; Israel to free 2000 Palestinians
item.description: A significant hostage release is set to begin Monday morning. Hamas confirmed the deal, brokered by the United States. This exchange involves 48 hostages, primarily Israelis, held in Gaza. In return, Israel will release Palestinian detainees. This marks a crucial step towards de-escalation after prolonged conflict. The agreement aims to bring a fragile peace.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Diane Keaton passes away at 79: Oscar-winner known for 'Annie Hall' & 'Godfather'
item.description: Hollywood mourns the passing of Diane Keaton, the celebrated Oscar-winning actor. Keaton, known for her iconic roles in Annie Hall and The Godfather series, died at 79. Her distinctive style left an indelible mark on cinema. Fans and colleagues remember her significant contributions to film. She passed away peacefully in California.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Use all available funds’: Donald Trump orders Pentagon to pay troops amid shutdown - ‘won’t let Democrats hold nation hostage’
item.description: President Trump directed the Pentagon to use available funds to ensure troops receive their October 15 paychecks during the government shutdown. He criticized Democrats, accusing them of holding the military hostage. Trump urged Democrats to reopen the government to address other issues, while Republicans accused Democrats of not caring about military families' pay.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Earthquake jolts Pakistan: 5.0 magnitude quake strikes, second in a week
item.description: Pakistan experienced a 5.0 magnitude earthquake on Saturday evening at a shallow depth of 10 km, raising concerns about potential aftershocks. This marks the second tremor in October for the seismically active region. While no immediate damage or casualties were reported, the shallow nature of the quake increases ground shaking intensity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Party was 'picture perfect' - until it wasn't: US school superintendent recounts shooting horror; 4 dead
item.description: A peaceful homecoming celebration in Leland, Mississippi, turned tragic Friday night when gunfire erupted, killing four adults and injuring at least 12 others. The violence broke out during a community block party following a high school football game and tailgate. Officials are investigating the incident, which has devastated the small, low-crime town.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US military plant explosion: ‘No survivors’ found after Tennessee blast; at least 18 presumed dead
item.description: A massive explosion at a military explosives plant in Tennessee has resulted in no survivors found, with at least 18 people feared dead. Recovery efforts are underway at the Accurate Energetic Systems facility in McEwen, where the blast destroyed a building and scattered debris. The cause remains unknown, and the site is considered volatile.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Joe Biden’s cancer battle: Former US president undergoing treatment; spokesperson confirms radiation, hormone therapy
item.description: Former US President Joe Biden is undergoing radiation and hormone treatments for prostate cancer, diagnosed in May. The 82-year-old's office previously revealed an aggressive diagnosis that had spread to his bones. This news emerged following concerns about his health during his presidential campaign.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US school campus shooting: At least 4 dead, 12 injured in Mississippi; 18-yr old suspect at large
item.description: Tragedy struck Leland, Mississippi, early Saturday as a shooting during homecoming weekend claimed four lives and injured at least twelve. Crowds gathered on the main street for the high school festivities when the violence erupted. Authorities are actively investigating the incident, with the Mississippi Bureau of Investigation assisting local efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Balancing Islamabad: Why India’s Kabul outreach matters now - the Afghan comeback explained
item.description: India is upgrading its Kabul mission to a full embassy, signaling a significant diplomatic shift during Taliban Foreign Minister Muttaqi's visit. This move, without formal recognition, aims to enhance regional stability and counter terrorism. Muttaqi also strongly condemned Pakistan's alleged bombing of civilian areas in Afghanistan, highlighting a growing rift between Kabul and Islamabad.
item.dc:creator: Ayush Pandey

item.title: UAE: Dubai Police to unveil AI patrol cars, Smart Stations at the World’s Largest Tech Show, GITEX 2025
item.description: Dubai Police are showcasing advanced AI and autonomous technology at GITEX Global 2025, featuring AI-driven patrol vehicles and fully automated Smart Police Stations. This exhibition highlights the future of law enforcement and smart city innovations, offering a glimpse into cutting-edge public safety solutions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Health authorities shut down bakery in Al Ain after confirmed food poisoning case
item.description: Al Suweidaa Modern Bakery in Al Ain was closed by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority after a food poisoning case exposed major safety violations. The bakery failed to meet legal food handling standards, posing a public health threat. Operations are suspended until full compliance. Authorities urge the public to report unsafe food practices by calling 800 555.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE fans flood Doha as national team takes on Oman in bid for first World Cup spot in 35 years
item.description: In a high-stakes World Cup playoff, the UAE faces Oman in Doha on October 11, aiming for their first World Cup berth since 1990. With both teams vying for direct qualification, the match holds immense significance. UAE fans are out in force, supporting their team’s campaign, as they prepare for a crucial encounter against Qatar on October 14.

item.title: Bollywood couple alert! Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal spotted touring Abu Dhabi’s hidden gems
item.description: Bollywood couple Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal recently explored Abu Dhabi, finding peace at the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and experiencing thrilling adventures like F1 racing. Their visit, part of the 'Visit Abu Dhabi' campaign, showcased the city's blend of culture, innovation, and adrenaline, offering a glimpse into their shared journey and love.
